source_snapshot.procedure: Generic setup says clear logs; open Dashboard and Server Health > Sensor Reading.
source_snapshot.criteria: Sensor reading and threshold are human readable and match specification.
source_snapshot.deepseek: YES may read the literal record but truncates fallback inventory and does not define CEMBB, identify its assembly/revision/probe zone, distinguish it from slot/card sensors or capture CEM population, cooling state and complete UI/spec evidence.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION requires platform CEMBB meaning/location, complete fields, UI mapping and approved reference/airflow context.

old_problem: A plausible named reading could be accepted after guessing CEMBB meant a backplane or baseboard, without proving the exact assembly revision and probe zone or distinguishing it from CEM-slot and card telemetry. The acceptance mode and CEM population/cooling state were also undefined.
disposition_reason: Keep CEMBB unexpanded until the Project defines it, then bind the stable record and both UI rows to the exact assembly/revision and probe zone. Record CEM/riser/card population and passive cooling state, and apply either an approved static range/status criterion or a non-intrusive calibrated-reference criterion. These are Project execution inputs rather than unresolved review logic.
decision_basis: XLSX row 881, same-row DeepSeek, exact GPT V2, internal Script reference, selection manifest and historical record were directly reviewed.
CEMBB is a vendor platform label; backboard, backplane and baseboard expansions cannot be selected without the Project assembly map.
A dedicated assembly thermal zone is not interchangeable with a CEM slot or add-in-card internal sensor, and static range/status is not calibrated accuracy.
ED-15 requires an approved acceptance criterion, ED-17 rejects log clearing, and ED-20 preserves CEMBB as its own coverage.

test_case.test_name: Verify TEMP CEMBB against the Project-defined assembly, probe zone and passive thermal criterion
test_case.purpose: After the Project defines CEMBB, verify its temperature record maps to the exact intended assembly/revision and probe zone and is human readable in Dashboard and Server Health with correct value, units, health, implemented thresholds/hysteresis and freshness under the documented CEM population and passive cooling state.
required_package: Authoritative Project definition of CEMBB and exact chassis/board/CEM assembly PN/revision plus BMC/BIOS identity
Assembly drawing locating the CEMBB sensing point and thermal zone relative to CEM slots, cards, risers and airflow
Stable SDR/API name/number/type/entity/instance and corresponding Dashboard and Server Health rows
Approved static-range/status or calibrated-accuracy criterion with units/scaling, thresholds/hysteresis, freshness and tolerance
CEM slot/riser/card population, card power/load, fan mode/speeds, panels/ducts, airflow and timestamps
If accuracy is required, approved non-intrusive calibrated reference placement, calibration validity, combined uncertainty and update lag
Validated protected OOB/API/browser clients and pinned immutable reviewed `sensor.git` revision/checksum or approved manual read-only method
test_case.test_command: Do not clear logs, remove/reseat CEM cards or risers, open/remove panels or ducts, reset/load cards, change fans/airflow or write thresholds. Confirm the authoritative CEMBB expansion, exact assembly/revision and probe zone and select the approved static or calibrated criterion. Resolve one stable TEMP CEMBB identity from the complete repository; review the Script before use. Capture its complete value, units, capability/threshold/hysteresis, health and timestamp plus unchanged Dashboard and Server Health rows. Record CEM population, card state and passive cooling state. Apply approved limits or, only with a non-intrusive setup, a time-aligned reference and combined uncertainty. Stop without retry on missing, duplicate, stale or divergent identity.
test_case.expected_result: One stable record and both UI rows map to the Project-defined CEMBB assembly/revision and probe zone. Complete OOB/UI value, units, threshold capability/values, health and freshness agree with specification and satisfy the selected static criterion or approved non-intrusive reference tolerance under the recorded passive state. CEM-slot/card/generic chassis telemetry does not substitute and hardware/airflow remains unchanged.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires authoritative CEMBB meaning, assembly/probe identity, complete OOB and both-UI agreement, the named acceptance mode and engineer verdict for all applicable fields. A guessed acronym, readable/plausible value, slot/card sensor, truncated output or command success alone cannot pass. Wrong/duplicate/stale identity, out-of-limit value or required field/threshold/status/UI mismatch is FAIL. Missing definition/map/spec/criterion/reviewed method is NOT READY, not Pending or PASS; static range does not claim calibrated accuracy or per-slot coverage.
safety_gate: Do not clear SEL/system logs; CEM/PCIe, fan and thermal history is relevant evidence.
Do not expand CEMBB from the label or substitute CEM-slot, card-internal or generic chassis telemetry.
Do not service/reset/load cards or risers, open panels/ducts, change fans/airflow/environment or write thresholds.
Any accuracy reference must be non-intrusive and must not alter airflow; intrusive setup requires a separate approved plan.
Keep static range/status and calibrated accuracy distinct and preserve identity, capability, units, status and timestamps.
Do not truncate output, expose credentials or run an unreviewed Script; no automatic retry.
expected_evidence: Project-approved CEMBB definition; chassis/board/CEMBB assembly PN/revision, BMC/BIOS and CEM slot/riser/card population identity
Authoritative probe-zone/airflow map and complete stable raw identity, value, units, threshold capabilities/values, health and timestamp
Separate unchanged Dashboard and Server Health evidence mapped to the same assembly record
Card/riser load/power, fan policy/speeds, panels/ducts and airflow state with timestamps
Approved static comparison or non-intrusive calibrated reference with placement, uncertainty and update-lag calculation
Pinned Script or alternate-method audit, no-clear/no-write/no-service-or-airflow-change/no-retry proof, final PCIe/cooling/BMC health and engineer verdict
test_case.recovery: No mutation is expected. On acronym, assembly, probe or identity ambiguity, stale/divergent values, unexpected health change or reference airflow disturbance, stop and preserve the first complete evidence and CEM/cooling state. Remove only an authorized non-intrusive reference fixture and use approved read-only diagnostics; any separately authorized hardware/configuration change is restored by the platform owner.

source_conflict.reason: The vendor acronym is underdefined, but Items, UI Procedure and Criteria consistently request passive validation of one named temperature record. Project definition resolves identity without changing purpose.

blocked.reason: The passive named target is identifiable. CEMBB expansion, assembly/probe map, cooling state and acceptance are supplyable Project inputs.

pending.remaining_project_configuration: CEMBB definition, assembly/revision/probe map, stable sensor/UI identity, selected static or accuracy criterion, values/thresholds/status/freshness, CEM/cooling state, optional safe reference and protected reviewed method.
pending.execution_status: NOT STARTED; READ ONLY; SCRIPT NOT APPROVED

external_authorities.title: Master-referenced internal sensor Script
external_authorities.application: Use only after immutable pinning and safety review; it cannot define CEMBB or its physical assembly/probe.

project_authority: CEMBB terminology and assembly/sensor-placement drawing, CEM topology, SDR thermal limits, airflow spec, WebUI schema and Project configuration define identity and acceptance.
